scientific_integrity: The claimed all-pairs metric is supported by complete finite enumeration plus a structural bijection from feedback tables to de Bruijn cycles; the packaged standalone checker reproduces each integer count. Earlier connectivity, Hamiltonicity, degree distribution and clique results are expressly not claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite order-five cross-join graph only; no arbitrary-order bound.
The distance metric counts single cross-join operations and not arbitrary feedback changes or cyclic index span.
A directly relevant 2020 paper and 2026 paper were available only through limited accessible material; historical priority is subject to independent confirmation.
title: Exact cross-join graph distances among binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
